full_details: You had not slept since two. On the tables the old line was still there, cloves, Yaxley with his question mark, and the lark. You did not wipe it. She spoke first, and she lied: the nightingale, and not the lark. He answered that the night was done, and then he stayed because she asked. No lark sang. There were rooks. Your own candle was at the socket when the pane went grey. Eighty lines, down to the woes, and the nurse at the door. At grey first light the sheet was half filled, and the clove-wool was still in the saucer. At dinner she had counted three candles to the socket on Tuesday. You said Tuesday was the tooth, and the lovers were this morning, and they burned one. They parted at sunrise. She said they had more sense than you. You entered the cloves at two pence, the same two pence, and no new total. At two you were Titus again, off in the fourth. The reckoning after was thirty-eight shillings. The king this week was Tuesday, once. The next is the sixteenth. The glass stayed locked. The Rose had 1 Hercules. You did not go. At night, in the rain, with aquavitae on a clout, you copied three leaves fair, the crown handed across and the glass called for, folded them once, and laid them under the account book. You did not say why.
one_sentence: You wrote their dawn at a real one, heard that they had more sense than you, played Titus, and put thirty-eight shillings down.
title: The nightingale and the lark, then thirty-eight shillings
